name: DEXUS
summary: Dexus is a leading Australasian fully integrated real asset group, managing a high-quality Australasian real estate and infrastructure portfolio valued at 51.4 billion dollars. The Dexus Platform includes the Dexus listed portfolio and the funds management business. The 15.3 billion dollars listed portfolio includes direct and indirect ownership of office, industrial, retail, healthcare, infrastructure, alternatives and other investments. They manage a further 36.1 billion dollars of investment in our funds management business which connects third party capital with exposure to quality sector specific and diversified real asset products.
